responsibility: Implements the RTL doloop optimization that converts countable loops into target low-overhead hardware loop forms. It analyzes simple loop exits and iteration counts via RTL induction-variable information, validates profitability and target constraints, recognizes and checks generated doloop patterns, ensures the replacement does not clobber live-out registers, and rewrites the loop latch/control sequence to use targetm.gen_doloop_end and related branch-on-count-register machinery. This is the target-facing loop-control lowering pass for hardware loop instructions, not generic unrolling or scheduling.
